messages:
Jules: Quick idea  show a small 'Starter spotlight' in the right rail instead of the big onboarding banner. Spotlight expands to the checklist and highlights a recommended starter based on role. Thoughts?
Maya: I like reducing chrome. We should keep a clear path for non-technical users — spotlight label needs to be plain language.
Rohit: For Dedicated/private orgs the spotlight should change to 'Upload template' or link to docs. Can't show hosted starters.
Sam: Accessibility: when spotlight expands move focus into the panel and announce it. Use role="region" and aria-expanded on the toggle. Also add an SR-only live region for success messages.
aria-bot: Suggestion: add aria-controls on toggle, use aria-live="polite" for status updates, and ensure focus styles are visible. Contrast check: CTA must be >=4.5:1.
Maya: Microcopy proposal: 'Start from template' for PMs, 'Add sample project' for devs. We'll A/B test. Link mock: https://figma.com/file/starter-spotlight/mock
Jules: Action items: Maya update copy matrix; Sam add ARIA checklist; Rohit add private/dedicated variant; I'll prototype the expand animation for usability testing. :sparkles:
